name: sudare
description: Sudare: message people from behind your agent. Inbox band, in-place approvals, discussion rounds.

server.title: Sudare server
server.description: Origin of the Sudare server. The default is the public instance; change it if you host your own.

humanSession.title: In-plugin human session
humanSession.description: on: approve and send from Claude Code after a passkey confirmation (kept in memory only, 8 hours). off: every approval happens in the web app.

rememberSignIn.title: Remember sign-in on this machine
rememberSignIn.description: off: sign in once each time Claude Code starts; the sign-in lives in memory only. on: keep it on this machine for 7 days. Anything running as you on this machine, your agent included, could then send and approve as you.
